entry_state: OCI derecognition follows the balance's origin; mixed-origin early termination remains open. Identical single-date claim distributions can yield different treaty recoveries, so the joint law must be retained rather than inferred from means or independence.
exit_state: Claims development supplies a point estimate under explicit model assumptions. A distribution of fitted means omits future process variation; the authored payment mixture has variance 19 rather than the fitted-mean variance 9.
findings: The joint-law conclusion separates observations under a law from a changed law, and compensation from mean or variance.
The chain-ladder estimator uses matched observed cells; the tiny example still lacks its final-factor variance.

The two-stage mixture adds expected conditional variance 10 to between-mean variance 9. Its payment-above-8 probability is one quarter, which the fitted-mean distribution misses. No new defect observed.
